module: Flowgraph node "Apply Velocity to Vehicle" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags boost/thrust/move). Instantly gives a velocity to a vehicle by calling `thrusters.applyVelocity(vec)` in the vehicle VM. Input pins: `vehId` (number), `dirVec` (vec3, otherwise vehicle direction), `coefficient` (number, default 1, multiplier of the vector). No output. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: `work` runs every frame while the flow is active: the velocity is reapplied every frame.
The vector is serialized as is into a Lua command; unit = m/s (inferred from the name of the thrusters function, not verified here).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Finds the vehicle, builds the vector (dirVec or vehicle direction) multiplied by `coefficient`, then sends `thrusters.applyVelocity(...)` to the vehicle VM.
